method: Seven groups of four full 1100x780 PNG images viewed individually with detail=original: reduction and literal controls at front0 and oblique1 for each of seven states. Every listed capture was actually displayed and visually inspected.
limits: Visual review checks visible assembly/appearance/composition. Exact dimensions, all geometry/accessor bytes, source identity, PNG pixels/UVs and motion values are established by the independent numerical/native readers, not inferred as measurements from these screenshots.

captures.review_method: Direct original-resolution view_image inspection; no contact sheet or substituted render.
findings: Both modes show the same six labeled panels in two separated groups and a gray marker below. Baseline left-group widths and the sibling right-panel width are visibly distinct; all labels remain upright and readable.
Front view exposes all six complete label faces and the gray marker without clipping or occlusion; the header identifies the exact role and 0-second state.
No visible missing face, clipping, unexpected extra occurrence, texture reversal, or control-mode discrepancy.
